title: Trove home energy interval
description: One line of home/<source>/energy/YYYY-MM.jsonl: metered consumption or production over an interval beginning at ts. Electricity fills kwh; other commodities (gas, water) use value + unit. Additive evolution: readers tolerate unknown fields.

ts.description: RFC3339 local time the interval starts

source.description: collector id; identical to the source folder name (lowercase/digits/dash)

circuit.description: sub-channel within the device: a circuit (Emporia), a plug, a commodity meter ("gas-meter")

kwh.description: electricity for the interval, in kilowatt-hours (the named common case)

value.description: quantity when the commodity isn't electricity (gas, water), paired with unit

unit.description: unit of value: therm, ccf, gal, m3, wh (omit when kwh carries it)

interval_secs.description: length of the bucket in seconds (3600 = hourly, 900 = 15-min)

direction.description: flow direction of the metered quantity

guid.description: source-unique id, the dedupe key; else the natural key (device/circuit + metric + ts) keeps re-runs from duplicating
